input.summary: Extend § 13.1 Services licence to Affiliates and contractors and remove revocability at Vendor's discretion
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Services licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and removed revocation at Vendor's sole discretion so that revocation follows the notice-and-cure standard already agreed in § 13.3. This aligns § 13.1 with §§ 13.2-13.3 and our playbook position that the licence cover Affiliates and contractors and not be revocable at will.

ops.oldText: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a licence, revocable or suspendable only as permitted by Section 13.3 and transferable as permitted by Section 13.3, to use the Services.
